name: pl-notification
title: A ChRIS plugin for notification through mail / Slack / Element
description: A ChRIS Plugin for notification through mail / Slack / Element

parameters.name: content
parameters.help: Content of the notification. Optionally specified in [inputdir]/.notification.yaml if not specified in argument.

parameters.name: title
parameters.help: [Optional] Title of the notification. Optionally specified in [inputdir]/.notification.yaml if not specified in argument.

parameters.name: slack_url
parameters.help: [Optional] slack-url if we want to send notification through Slack. Optionally specified in [inputdir]/.notification.yaml if not specified in argument.

parameters.name: element_room
parameters.help: [Optional] element-room (ex: ![room-id]:fedora.im) if we want to send notification through Element. Optionally specified in [inputdir]/.notification.yaml if not specified in argument.

parameters.name: element_token
parameters.help: [Optional] element-token if we want to send notification through Element. Required if element-url exists. Optionally specified in [inputdir]/.notification.yaml if not specified in argument.

parameters.name: element_host
parameters.help: [Optional] element-host if we want to send notification through Element. [inputdir]/.notification.yaml is with higher priority than command-line based config.

parameters.name: rcpt
parameters.help: [Optional] comma separated email receipients if we want to send notification through email. Optionally specified in [inputdir]/.notification.yaml if not specified in argument.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.help: sender (From) in email. [inputdir]/.notification.yaml is with higher priority than command-line based config.

parameters.name: mail_server
parameters.help: email server. [inputdir]/.notification.yaml is with higher priority than command-line based config.
